lines.en: Welcome to the apartment, Luisa! Oh, and I would rather you did not smoke inside, if you do not mind.
lines.pt: Bem-vinda ao apartamento, Luisa! Ah, e eu preferiria que você não fumasse aqui dentro, se não se importar.

lines.en: Of course, sorry. I did not know. I would rather go out to the balcony than annoy anybody. Is that okay?
lines.pt: Claro, desculpe. Eu não sabia. Prefiro ir até a varanda do que incomodar alguém. Tudo bem?

lines.en: The balcony is fine, thanks. My sister has asthma and she is staying with me, so I keep the smell outside.
lines.pt: A varanda está ótima, obrigado. Minha irmã tem asma e está hospedada comigo, então mantenho o cheiro lá fora.

lines.en: That makes sense. Honestly, I would rather not smoke at all. I have been trying to quit since January.
lines.pt: Faz sentido. Sinceramente, preferiria nem fumar. Estou tentando parar desde janeiro.

lines.en: I did not know that! Do you want a coffee or a tea? I have mint tea if you want something calming.
lines.pt: Não sabia! Quer um café ou um chá? Tenho chá de menta se quiser algo calmante.

lines.en: I would rather have coffee, please, strong and black. I need it to start the day,.
lines.pt: Prefiro café, por favor, forte e puro. Preciso dele para começar o dia.

lines.en: Strong and black, coming up. By the way, would you rather we ate here or went to the restaurant downstairs?
lines.pt: Forte e puro, saindo. A propósito, você prefere que a gente coma aqui ou vá ao restaurante lá embaixo?

lines.en: I would rather we ate here. Restaurants in this neighborhood are expensive, and I have not been paid yet.
lines.pt: Prefiro que a gente coma aqui. Os restaurantes deste bairro são caros, e eu ainda não recebi.

lines.en: Perfect. I like cooking anyway. I am making pasta with spinach, and I will serve it with a big salad.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Gosto de cozinhar de qualquer jeito. Vou fazer macarrão com espinafre e servir com uma salada grande.

lines.en: Sounds wonderful. I would rather you did not make too much, though. I had a late lunch with my boss.
lines.pt: Parece ótimo. Mas preferia que você não fizesse demais. Almocei tarde com meu chefe.

lines.en: No problem. We can save the rest for tomorrow, and you can take some home if you want.
lines.pt: Sem problema. Podemos guardar o resto para amanhã, e você pode levar um pouco para casa, se quiser.

items.wrong: I would rather you do not smoke.
items.fix: I would rather you did not smoke.
items.why: Depois de would rather + pessoa, use o passado.

items.wrong: I would rather to go out.
items.why: Would rather é seguido de verbo sem to.

items.wrong: I prefer that you do not smoke here.
items.fix: I would rather you did not smoke here.
items.why: Prefer that soa mais formal; would rather é natural.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: I would rather you do not smoke. → I would rather you did not smoke. | I would rather to go out. → I would rather go out. | I prefer that you do not smoke here. → I would rather you did not smoke here..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I would rather you did not smoke is a polite request.
items.why: It is gentle and common among friends.

items.s: After would rather you, the verb goes in the past form.
items.why: I would rather you left, not leave.

items.s: Would rather you did means I want you to do it in the past.
items.why: The past form talks about now or the future.

answers: I would rather you did not smoke is a polite request. → Verdadeiro (It is gentle and common among friends.)
After would rather you, the verb goes in the past form. → Verdadeiro (I would rather you left, not leave.)
Would rather you did means I want you to do it in the past. → Falso (The past form talks about now or the future.)

My sister has asthma and she is staying with me, so I keep the smell outside.” says Blake.

Bem-vinda ao apartamento, Luisa! Ah, e eu preferiria que você não fumasse aqui dentro, se não se importar.
You
Of course, sorry. I did not know. I would rather go out to the balcony than annoy anybody. Is that okay?
Claro, desculpe. Eu não sabia. Prefiro ir até a varanda do que incomodar alguém. Tudo bem?
Blake
The balcony is fine, thanks. My sister has asthma and she is staying with me, so I keep the smell outside.
A varanda está ótima, obrigado. Minha irmã tem asma e está hospedada comigo, então mantenho o cheiro lá fora.
You
That makes sense. Honestly, I would rather not smoke at all. I have been trying to quit since January.
Faz sentido. Sinceramente, preferiria nem fumar. Estou tentando parar desde janeiro.
Blake
I did not know that! Do you want a coffee or a tea? I have mint tea if you want something calming.
Não sabia! Quer um café ou um chá? Tenho chá de menta se quiser algo calmante.
You
I would rather have coffee, please, strong and black. I need it to start the day,.
Prefiro café, por favor, forte e puro. Preciso dele para começar o dia.

pages.title: Conversa · final
lines: Blake
Strong and black, coming up. By the way, would you rather we ate here or went to the restaurant downstairs?
Forte e puro, saindo. A propósito, você prefere que a gente coma aqui ou vá ao restaurante lá embaixo?
You
I would rather we ate here. Restaurants in this neighborhood are expensive, and I have not been paid yet.
Prefiro que a gente coma aqui. Os restaurantes deste bairro são caros, e eu ainda não recebi.
Blake
Perfect. I like cooking anyway. I am making pasta with spinach, and I will serve it with a big salad.
Perfeito. Gosto de cozinhar de qualquer jeito. Vou fazer macarrão com espinafre e servir com uma salada grande.
You
Sounds wonderful. I would rather you did not make too much, though. I had a late lunch with my boss.
Parece ótimo. Mas preferia que você não fizesse demais. Almocei tarde com meu chefe.
Blake
No problem. We can save the rest for tomorrow, and you can take some home if you want.
Sem problema. Podemos guardar o resto para amanhã, e você pode levar um pouco para casa, se quiser.
